data.value: Saved results have not been read.

data.name: AbsentDetail
data.value: This run has no saved path result to display. This does not establish that no route exists.

data.name: UnknownDetail
data.value: The saved analysis does not establish a supported route for this object. This is not a finding that the object is safe.

data.name: Boundary
data.value: This displays saved membership and permission evidence, not account takeover or proof that a live operation succeeded. Permission to change a target's permissions does not establish the ability to act as that target.

data.name: ShorterUnknown
data.value: Unsupported alternatives might be shorter. This is one recorded supported route, not all routes or a remediation recommendation.

data.name: ZeroDistance
data.value: Shortest proven route: 0 steps. The object is already a fixed Tier 0 target; no extra hop is added.

data.name: Generation
ChecksCaveat
data.value: Automatic account checks cover only the supported questions. Explicit saved questions are separate. A completed scan or zero questions establishes neither forest-wide coverage nor safety.

data.name: CoverageScope
data.value: These limitations describe the saved analysis scope. A gap does not erase an independently supported route, and is not necessarily a gap affecting this object.

data.name: CapturedIncomplete
data.value: Missing captured evidence: required directory evidence is incomplete.

data.name: Unsupported
data.value: Unsupported analysis: this build does not evaluate every possible relationship or operation.

data.name: UnfinishedProcessing
data.value: Unfinished processing: the saved input work did not complete.

data.name: UnresolvedQuestions
data.value: Some saved supported questions remain unresolved; completing their evaluation did not establish their authorization or membership outcome.

data.name: Degraded
data.value: The saved judging completed with limitations. This is not a clean-forest result.

data.name: Unfinished
data.value: An unpublished analysis attempt is present or the saved judging did not finish. A retained earlier generation is not shown as this attempt's result; this does not establish whether a worker is currently running.

data.name: InvalidEvidence
data.value: The saved result or its supporting evidence could not be validated.

data.name: GenerationChanged
data.value: The saved result and its source generation do not match, or the selected generation changed while reading. The result is withheld.

data.name: SubjectChanged
data.value: The saved result identifies a different object. The result is withheld.
